fields.text: Turn a brand brief into a square favicon concept. GLM Flash condenses the brief; Muse renders one image (image step $0.01, plus text). Inspect at 16px; export or convert to favicon sizes separately.
Lumen — pocket weather radio. One lighthouse beam as a chevron. Deep navy field, single warm-gold mark. No letters.

fields.system: Write one concise image prompt for a favicon concept from the brand brief. Preserve the requested symbol and colors. One simple bold geometric glyph, centered with generous margins on a solid contrasting square background; flat fills, no tiny detail, gradients, shadows, text, initials, mockup or border. It should remain recognizable at 16 pixels. Output only the prompt, at most 80 words.
